_comment: Frozen run config for the six mix_scale_* budget points (2026-08-30). One file, not six copies: the six points must differ only in D. `harness run point` reads this and refuses a disagreeing CLI flag; check_ladder_config compares every ladder checkpoint's cfg against it. A change to any value reopens the whole ladder. Two kinds of fields: (1) CLI-settable (_FROZEN_KEYS) — every Cfg field with a CLI flag that changes the architecture or the recipe, excluding seed; check_frozen_keys_complete enforces this against train.py's parser. (2) Code-only (_CODE_FROZEN_KEYS) — architecture constants with no CLI flag, recorded as documented intent so a code edit before the first point diverges from a recorded value and fails. chunk_size is a code constant (Cfg.chunk_size=32, no CLI flag); NCCL protocol is default. Bool fields match Cfg defaults, so no flag is needed to achieve them — _strip_frozen refuses a flag that would change one. See docs/standards/0830v1_gates.md. SPLIT 2026-08-30: `world` is the RECIPE (card count changes the effective batch and the gradient noise, so it changes the optimisation); `cards` is the ALLOCATION (which H20s, which changes no computation). They were one string, and NGPU was split out of it, so editing the list to dodge a busy card silently changed the count with nothing raising. run point now asserts len(cards) == world and that every named card is idle. `world` is deliberately in NEITHER frozen-key tuple: train.py does not stamp it into a checkpoint's cfg, so comparing it there would report UNKNOWN forever -- it is enforced at the launch gate, which is the only place it can actually be checked today. REALLOCATED 2026-08-30: cards 1-7 -> 0-6, world still 7. This is the allocation half moving and the recipe half standing still, which is the whole reason they were split: eight H20s are identical and any seven span the same NVSwitch domain, so card IDENTITY changes no computation. GPU 0 being the bench lane is an operating convention, not part of the recipe. The six ladder points ran on 1-7 and stay comparable. WARMDOWN/ANNEAL_FRAC ADDED 2026-09-01: 8199ee0 put both into _FROZEN_KEYS and did not add them here, so frozen[k] raised KeyError and check_ladder_config died before checking ANY key -- the crash was mistaken for the check running, and the other 20 keys went unverified from 8/31 16:15. Values are train.py Cfg defaults (0.65, 0.10), read from the source rather than chosen: every ladder point ran without a flag for either, so those are the values the six points DID run. This records what happened; it does not decide what the 500M run should run -- a stage-1 WSD join wants warmdown=0 and anneal_frac=0, which is the launch owner's recipe decision. The rule above guards a CHANGE to a value, not a RECORD of the value that ran (fb ruling 2026-09-01).
